declarations.name: AuiOrgChart

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Accessible name of the tree (aria-label); the toolbar is named '{label} controls'. Non-empty.

inputs.name: expanded
inputs.description: Explicitly expanded node ids (overrides expandDepth). Read the current set from the expanded getter.

inputs.name: selected
inputs.description: Selected node id (aria-selected=true).

inputs.name: renderNode
inputs.description: Card content ({ depth, expanded, childCount, doc } context). Return non-interactive content: the treeitem is the control and its text is its accessible name. Default: initials, label, title, description.

inputs.name: loadChildren
inputs.description: Loads the reports of a node with hasChildren on its first expansion (validated; each parentId must be a known or returned node). Rejections and timeouts keep the node collapsed, announce the failure, and emit aui-load-error.

inputs.name: editable
inputs.description: Edit mode: re-parent nodes by pointer drag onto the new manager, Ctrl/Cmd+X then Ctrl/Cmd+V, or the toolbar Move / Move here buttons; undo and redo.

inputs.name: canMove
inputs.description: Veto a move (edit mode and moveNode). Cycles and locked nodes are always refused.

inputs.name: historyLimit
inputs.description: Undo depth, integer 0..500 (0 disables history).

inputs.name: nodeRadius
inputs.description: Card corner radius in CSS px, 0..50. Unset: --aui-chart-node-radius, else --aui-chart-corner-radius, else the theme's radius-md. Written as --aui-chart-node-radius through the CSSOM; the SVG export keeps it.

inputs.name: orientation
inputs.description: 'vertical': managers above their reports (top-down); 'horizontal': managers at the inline start, reports toward the inline end.

inputs.name: nodeWidth
inputs.description: Card width in CSS px, integer 80..600.

inputs.name: nodeHeight
inputs.description: Card height in CSS px, integer 32..400.

inputs.name: siblingGap
inputs.description: Space between neighboring cards of a level, integer 4..400 CSS px.

inputs.name: levelGap
inputs.description: Space between levels (connector length), integer 16..400 CSS px.

inputs.name: expandDepth
inputs.description: Levels expanded initially when `expanded` is not given (integer 0..64; 0 shows only the top-level nodes).

inputs.name: minZoom
inputs.description: Smallest zoom factor, 0.05..1.

inputs.name: maxZoom
inputs.description: Largest zoom factor, 1..8.

inputs.name: requestTimeoutMs
inputs.description: loadChildren timeout in ms (integer 100..600000); the signal is aborted with a TimeoutError.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Locale of search, typeahead, report counts, zoom percentages, and messages.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: rtl mirrors the layout (first report on the right; horizontal charts grow to the left) and swaps ArrowLeft/ArrowRight.

models.name: nodes
models.description: Flat nodes: { id (unique), parentId (manager id or null for a top-level node), label (name), title?, description?, hasChildren? (reports exist but load through loadChildren), locked? (cannot be moved in edit mode) }. Validated: unique ids, known parents, no cycles (ORG_CHART_OPTIONS). Sibling order follows the array. Replacing it with update() clears the undo history.

outputs.name: nodeSelected
outputs.description: A node was selected by click, Enter, or Space.

outputs.name: expandChange
outputs.description: A node was expanded (after its reports loaded) or collapsed through the UI or setExpanded.

outputs.name: nodeMoved
outputs.description: A node got a new manager (drag, paste, toolbar, moveNode, undo, redo). Save detail.nodes or send the change to the server.

outputs.name: zoomed
outputs.description: The zoom changed through the toolbar, keys, Ctrl/Cmd + wheel, or zoomTo (fit does not emit).

outputs.name: loadError
outputs.description: loadChildren rejected, timed out, or returned invalid nodes.

methods.name: setExpanded
methods.signature: setExpanded(id: string, expanded: boolean): Promise<void> | undefined
methods.description: Expand (loading lazy reports first) or collapse a node. Emits aui-expand-change.

methods.name: expandAll
methods.description: Expand every node with loaded reports (lazy nodes are not loaded) / collapse all.

methods.name: collapseAll
methods.description: Expand every node with loaded reports (lazy nodes are not loaded) / collapse all.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Ids whose label, title, or description contains the text (case-insensitive, locale-aware), in tree order, including collapsed nodes.

methods.name: pathTo
methods.description: Ids from the top-level node down to the node.

methods.name: reveal
methods.signature: reveal(id: string, options?: { focus?: boolean; select?: boolean; highlight?: boolean; } | undefined): void | undefined
methods.description: Expand the node's managers, center it, highlight its path (cards and connectors; default on), focus it (default) and optionally select it; announces 'Path: A, B, C.'

methods.name: select
methods.description: Select a node without emitting aui-node-select.

methods.name: centerOn
methods.description: Center the view on a visible node (keeps the zoom).

methods.name: fit
methods.description: Scale (at most 100 %) and center the whole visible chart in the viewport; announces the zoom.

methods.name: zoomTo
methods.description: Zoom around the viewport center, clamped to minZoom..maxZoom; announces 'Zoom {percent}' and emits aui-zoom.

methods.name: moveNode
methods.signature: moveNode(id: string, parentId: string | null, index?: number | undefined): boolean | undefined
methods.description: Re-parent a node (index among the new siblings, default last; null parent = top level). Returns false (and announces) when refused: cycle, locked node, or canMove. Undoable; emits aui-node-move.

methods.name: undo
methods.description: Undo / redo the last move (parent and position). Announce and emit aui-node-move (reason 'undo' / 'redo'); false when there is nothing to undo/redo.

methods.name: redo
methods.description: Undo / redo the last move (parent and position). Announce and emit aui-node-move (reason 'undo' / 'redo'); false when there is nothing to undo/redo.

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Tree View (single select) with flat treeitems carrying aria-level, aria-setsize, and aria-posinset, kept in DOM reading order, with one roving tab stop. Connectors are decorative SVG. Moves in edit mode use cut/paste keys and toolbar buttons (no deprecated ARIA drag-and-drop attributes) with live-region announcements.

limitations: Every visible node is rendered (no virtualization); keep visible nodes to a few thousand with expandDepth and lazy loading.
Cards have a fixed size (nodeWidth, nodeHeight); long text is truncated with an ellipsis (the full text stays in the accessible name).
Moves change the manager and append the node last among its new siblings (moveNode takes an index); sibling reordering has no keyboard command.
A plain mouse wheel scrolls the page; zooming needs Ctrl/Cmd + wheel, the toolbar, or keys. Pinch zoom is not provided.
Pointer drags start on the background (pan) or, in edit mode, on a node (move); pointer drags are not announced (keyboard and toolbar moves are).
Export redraws cards with label and title only; custom renderNode content is not exported.
Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
